name: super-editor-business-skills
description: Codex business workflows for teaching semantic transformation rules from complete Super Editor books, compiling specialized skills, and running verified batches with atomic editor capabilities.

interface.longDescription: 在 super-editor-control 原子能力之上提供独立业务工作流。连接完整原课件和用户指定样章，通过自然语言教授和修正规则，试制后导出书类与样章专属 Skill，并以前向验证、来源追溯和批量账本安全执行；不依赖固定插槽或旧任务体系。
